subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative unit coverage as sufficient proof for this provider-side xAI/Grok code-less rotation error?
rationale: The contributor states the exact xAI code-less decrypt error cannot be induced on demand, while the normal ClawSweeper PR gate expects after-fix real behavior proof from a real setup.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Mark proof as overridden and proceed with normal maintainer review because the patch only widens the existing bounded retry predicate for a non-inducible provider error.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR open until a future xAI rotation produces redacted gateway logs showing the retry succeeds after this patch.

options.title: Require direct live reproduction
options.body: Keep the proof blocker in place even if that means the PR cannot land until xAI emits the exact event again.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Mark proof as overridden and proceed with normal maintainer review because the patch only widens the existing bounded retry predicate for a non-inducible provider error.

likelyOwner.reason: This proof decision is closest to the existing Responses retry recovery path that steipete authored and merged in the adjacent fix.
